en.meta.title: Vestra Player: a video player where every feature is a plugin
en.meta.description: The open-source video player that grows with its community — and with AI. For Windows and macOS: playback by libmpv, and every feature beyond playback is a plugin.
en.nav.label: Sections
en.hero.title: The open-source video player that grows with its community — and with AI
en.hero.lede: Vestra Player is a desktop video player for Windows and macOS. Playback by libmpv, a native interface, and everything beyond playback is a plugin you can install, remove or write.
en.hero.unsigned: Free test build, not code-signed yet
en.tour.title: See it in action
en.pl.title: Everything is a plugin
en.pl.lede: The playback bar, the playlist, subtitles and even the store are TypeScript plugins on one public API. Add more from the store in one click, or write your own.
en.ai.title: Describe a plugin, and AI builds it
en.ai.lede: Vestra Player AI writes, type-checks and tests the plugin; you install it with one click. It uses your own key for Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, OpenRouter, DeepSeek or an OpenAI-compatible service.
en.ai.s1.title: Describe
en.ai.s1.text: Tell Vestra Player AI what the plugin should do.
en.ai.s2.title: It builds and checks
en.ai.s2.text: It writes the plugin from the SDK documentation and fixes its own errors with the type check and tests, inside its own folder.
en.ai.s3.title: Install
en.ai.s3.text: Install the finished plugin in one click, or export it as a .vxp file or a complete source project.
en.ai.prompt: Show a small clock in the corner of the video.
en.os.title: Open from the engine to the store
en.os.player.title: The player
en.os.player.text: Playback by libmpv, the engine behind mpv, with a native Slint interface instead of a web page. Licensed under {player}.
en.os.sdk.title: The plugin API
en.os.sdk.text: Plugins are TypeScript on the public API from the plugin SDK, licensed under {plugins}: guides, an API reference and tested examples.
en.os.community.title: The community
en.os.community.text: Third-party plugins are reviewed as pull requests in the plugin repository, and the in-player store reads its signed index.
en.end.title: Free, open source, and every feature is yours to shape.
en.pf.title: All downloads
en.dl.fallback: Release details could not be loaded when this page was built. The release page has every file.
en.dl.note.installer: Installs for your user only, without administrator rights. Not code-signed yet: if SmartScreen warns, choose More info → Run anyway.
en.dl.note.portable: Unzip anywhere and run vestra-host.exe. Nothing is installed.
en.dl.note.dmg: Drag Vestra Player into Applications. Not notarized yet: on first launch open System Settings → Privacy & Security and click Open Anyway.
en.ft.licence: Vestra Player is licensed under {player}. The plugin SDK and the plugin repository are licensed under {plugins}.
en.ft.credits: Footage and games on this page
en.ft.privacy: No cookies, analytics or trackers. Your language choice is kept only in your browser.
en.ft.builtWith: Built on libmpv, Slint and Node.js.

zh-Hans.meta.title: Vestra Player：每个功能都是插件的视频播放器
zh-Hans.meta.description: 随社区与 AI 一起成长的开源播放器。适用于 Windows 和 macOS，由 libmpv 负责播放，播放之外的每个功能都是插件。
zh-Hans.nav.label: 页面导航
zh-Hans.hero.title: 随社区与 AI 一起成长的开源播放器
zh-Hans.hero.lede: Vestra Player 是一款适用于 Windows 和 macOS 的桌面视频播放器。由 libmpv 负责播放，界面原生；播放之外的一切都是插件，可以安装、移除，也可以自己写。
zh-Hans.hero.source: 在 GitHub 查看源代码
zh-Hans.hero.unsigned: 免费测试版，暂未代码签名
zh-Hans.tour.title: 看看实际效果
zh-Hans.pl.title: 一切皆插件
zh-Hans.pl.lede: 播放控制栏、播放列表、字幕，甚至插件商城本身，都是基于同一套公开 API 的 TypeScript 插件。在商城一键添加更多，或者自己写一个。
zh-Hans.ai.title: 说出想要的插件，AI 帮你做
zh-Hans.ai.lede: Vestra Player AI 会编写插件、做类型检查并运行测试，你一键即可安装。需使用你自己的 Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、OpenRouter、DeepSeek 或 OpenAI 兼容服务的密钥。
zh-Hans.ai.s1.title: 描述
zh-Hans.ai.s1.text: 告诉 Vestra Player AI 你想要插件做什么。
zh-Hans.ai.s2.title: 编写并检查
zh-Hans.ai.s2.text: 它根据 SDK 文档编写插件，借助类型检查和测试自行修正错误，全程只在自己的文件夹里操作。
zh-Hans.ai.s3.title: 安装
zh-Hans.ai.s3.text: 一键安装完成的插件，或导出为 .vxp 文件或完整的源代码项目。
zh-Hans.ai.prompt: 在视频角落显示一个小时钟。
zh-Hans.os.title: 从引擎到商城，全部开放
zh-Hans.os.player.title: 播放器
zh-Hans.os.player.text: 由 mpv 背后的引擎 libmpv 负责播放，界面使用原生 Slint，而不是网页。采用 {player} 许可。
zh-Hans.os.sdk.title: 插件 API
zh-Hans.os.sdk.text: 插件是基于插件 SDK 公开 API 的 TypeScript 程序，SDK 采用 {plugins} 许可，附有指南、API 参考和经过测试的示例。
zh-Hans.os.community.title: 社区
zh-Hans.os.community.text: 第三方插件在插件仓库中以拉取请求的形式接受审核，播放器内的商城读取该仓库带签名的索引。
zh-Hans.end.title: 免费、开源，每个功能都由你决定。
zh-Hans.pf.title: 全部下载
zh-Hans.dl.fallback: 构建本页面时未能获取版本信息。发布页上有全部文件。
zh-Hans.dl.note.installer: 仅为当前用户安装，无需管理员权限。暂未代码签名：如果 SmartScreen 发出警告，请点击更多信息 → 仍要运行。
zh-Hans.dl.note.portable: 解压到任意位置，运行 vestra-host.exe 即可，不会安装任何东西。
zh-Hans.dl.note.dmg: 把 Vestra Player 拖到“应用程序”文件夹。暂未经过公证：首次打开时请进入系统设置 → 隐私与安全性，点击仍要打开。
zh-Hans.ft.releases: 所有平台、校验值和旧版本
zh-Hans.ft.licence: Vestra Player 采用 {player} 许可。插件 SDK 和插件仓库采用 {plugins} 许可。
zh-Hans.ft.privacy: 本站不使用 Cookie、统计分析或任何追踪器。你的语言选择只保存在你自己的浏览器中。
zh-Hans.ft.builtWith: 基于 libmpv、Slint 和 Node.js 构建。
